name: Creative Hook Testing, Iteration & Fatigue Refresh
purpose: Systematically launch and isolate new creative hooks, formats, and angles into dedicated testing sandboxes before graduating winning assets into scaling campaigns.
triggerConditions: Ad frequency reaches > 3.0 on Meta or TikTok
Click-Through Rate (CTR) decays by > 25% over 14 days
New creative batch uploaded by client or agency
prerequisites: At least 3 new creative variations ready (different hooks, aspect ratios, or lead-in angles)
Creative testing ad set or Sandbox campaign created
Minimum statistical significance threshold established (e.g. 1000 impressions / $25 per variant)

executionSteps.name: Audit Creative Asset Specs & Formatting
executionSteps.action: Verify 9:16 vertical video formatting for TikTok & Reels, 1:1 for Feeds, and compliance with safe zones and text overlay limits

executionSteps.name: Deploy Isolated Creative Sandbox
executionSteps.action: Deploy new creative variations into a dedicated dynamic creative testing ad set with equalized budget distribution

executionSteps.name: Measure Hook Retention & Engagement
executionSteps.action: Analyze 3-second video hook rate, average watch time, outbound CTR, and initial conversion rate after 72 hours

executionSteps.name: Graduate Winning Creatives
executionSteps.action: Promote winning creative variants with highest conversion efficiency into primary scaling campaigns (ASC / PMax)

executionSteps.name: Retire & Archive Fatigued Ads
executionSteps.action: Gracefully pause old fatigued creative assets that have exceeded frequency saturation limits

successCriteria: Identification of at least 1 winning creative variation outperforming control CTR by >= 20%
Seamless graduation into scaling campaigns without pausing active learning
Creative fatigue decay reversed within 7 days

failureHandling.retryStrategy: Retry asset upload once if encoding or transcoding error occurs

rollbackStrategy: Immediately re-enable previous control creative if newly graduated variant fails to convert in the scaling ad set.
